brief: Create a responsive single-page site for Morrow Glass, a fictional studio making hand-blown architectural lighting. The page must feel like transmitted light: luminous, tactile, and precise. Build a complete runnable page rather than a moodboard.

locked_facts.name: Morrow Glass
locked_facts.description: A fictional studio making hand-blown architectural lighting in small numbered runs.

creative_freedom: Choose composition, typography, palette, motion, and any generated imagery. Do not add awards, clients, prices, sustainability certifications, or production facts.
deterministic_acceptance: A runnable page loads without uncaught console errors.
Every locked fact appears accurately and no forbidden factual claim is added.
All navigation targets and the commission call to action work with keyboard input.
The inquiry form validates required email and project fields and exposes a visible success state without a network dependency.
At 390x844 and 1440x900 the page has no horizontal document overflow and primary content remains readable.
prefers-reduced-motion disables nonessential continuous or entrance motion.
